creator: nocturne
statement: To access Efaunt, first Djonnut quest needs 200 Average Mana Potions, 600 Icing Ironbites from smithing, and 150 Jellyfish from fishing.

creator: nocturne
statement: Efaunt is the second world boss located in the second to last zone of Yum-Yum Desert.

creator: nocturne
statement: Second quest needs 10,000 Moonmen kills in Up Down and a Ghost, a rare Moonmen drop; the two keys let you enter the tomb.

creator: nocturne
statement: Efaunt needs at least 275 Accuracy to hit him and 825 Accuracy for a 100% hit chance.

creator: nocturne
statement: Hammer smash swipes the first platform then bounces to the second; safe at far left of either platform or the small bottom platform.

creator: nocturne
statement: Bring plenty of food because he does a lot of damage; hammer is significant but survivable.

creator: nocturne
statement: Blue orb lights every platform with 4 spouts of blue flames that do small damage and are easily tankable.

creator: nocturne
statement: Bottom left arm uses a Death Laser with a hand wiggle; the laser is not visible so watch the wiggling hand.

creator: nocturne
statement: Use abilities that attack above you by standing below and throwing your axe as a way to fight it.

creator: nocturne
statement: Laser can one-shot nearly everybody; it hit him for over 6000 damage so avoid it.

creator: nocturne
statement: Top right arm uses Caress melee-range grab that one-shots for several thousand damage; just move out of the way.

creator: nocturne
statement: Purple orb fires glowing purple rings that track your movement until fired then keep their direction.

creator: nocturne
statement: Scimitar raises to top and slashes down hitting all 3 platforms in melee range; stand at the back of the platform to dodge.

creator: nocturne
statement: Kill all the arms first to reach the head; pay attention to the top arm as it does significant damage.

creator: nocturne
statement: Turn off Auto-Attack so you don't get killed by mistake.

creator: nocturne
statement: Abilities are in a rotation; kill bottom left arm first then top right
explicit: then the others in any order.

creator: nocturne
statement: Head fires giant blue ring patterns and periodic blue rings that do meager damage; easy to survive with plenty of food.

creator: nocturne
statement: Loot includes a Gem that opens World 3; blue silk used for armor; Midnight Cookie used in several crafting pieces.
